title: DOMAIN GENERALIZATION - A CAUSAL PERSPECTIVE
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a survey on domain generalization from a causal perspective and does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is a technical survey on machine learning methods for domain generalization.
